directPaymentDiscovery.note: The official page publishes exact smartphone direct-payment prices. The current TCC direct-offer schema has no verified field/semantics for minimum turnover, so no runtime offer is emitted rather than silently dropping a price component.

reason: Primary evidence is sufficient for the tariff itself, but safe runtime integration is deferred because minimum-turnover semantics are not currently represented by the verified Germany direct-offer model.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Either a verified existing TCC field for minimum-turnover/minimum-session-charge semantics, or an explicit architecture decision to extend the pricing schema before emitting this direct offer.
